description: Optimal Residential Battery Storage Sizing Under ToU Tariffsand Dynamic Electricity Pricing is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Joško Novaković. The integration of renewable energy sources, particularly solar photovoltaics,into household power supply has become increasingly popular due to its potential toreduce energy costs and environmental impact. However, solar power variability andnew regulative changes concerning excess solar energy compensation schemes call foreffective energy storage management and sizing to ensure a stable and profitable electricitysupply. Coverage: a residential case study in Croatia. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1781632 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
